{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:27.079
    | text      = So Jordan, I think we can all agree that the world we are currently living in is a big
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:32.199
    | text      = fucking mess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.199
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:34.199
    | text      = It is a disaster on a lot of fronts.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:36.079
    | text      = And there's a certain amount of despair that it's easy to slip into because it often seems
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:40.600
    | text      = like we have a large segment of the country that doesn't see what's happening as a mess
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:46.319
    | text      = or even support it and are facilitating these things that are a mess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.000
    | text      = There are a lot of issues that we could focus on that you're seeing manifest in the world,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:57.399
    | text      = but our show is about Alex Jones and the right wing media.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:59.959
    | text      = So I think that one of the things that's important to discuss is liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.879
    | text      = In my lifetime, the most common reason why right wing and libertarian types insist that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:09.759
    | text      = we can't do anything to help people who are in need is because of concerns about liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:15.519
    | text      = We can't provide free lunches for school children because that would need to be paid for by
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:19.240
    | text      = taxes and that's an imposition on the liberty of those people paying taxes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:23.879
    | text      = Makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:24.879
    | text      = We can't have universal background checks for gun purchases because that's an imposition
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:28.939
    | text      = on gun owners' second amendment rights and thus their liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:33.120
    | text      = Social media sites shouldn't be allowed to ban your account for harassing people because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:36.799
    | text      = your harassment is just free speech and these sites shouldn't be messing with your liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:42.240
    | text      = To put things in very simple terms, a lot of people want to create a better world, but
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:46.679
    | text      = a small percentage don't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:48.799
    | text      = A lot of these people are the super rich people whose profits rely on us not creating a better
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:53.960
    | text      = world.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:54.960
    | text      = You can make a lot more money as a business person if you pay your employees crumbs and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:58.879
    | text      = avoid all OSHA regulations, or if those things didn't exist, it would help your profits.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.240
    | text      = Most of the population intuitively agrees with employers that they shouldn't exploit
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:10.980
    | text      = their employees, and when they hurt them, those employees should have recourse to hold
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:15.480
    | text      = those employers accountable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.059
    | text      = They have this intuitive understanding because far more people have the experience of being
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.480
    | text      = an employee and not an employer than have the experience of being an employer but never
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:27.419
    | text      = having been an employee.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.659
    | text      = Most people understand the inherent imbalance of power that exists within labor because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:33.340
    | text      = they've been on the powerless side of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:36.659
    | text      = One of the ways that the right-wing media gets people to side with the positions that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:39.879
    | text      = are opposite of their best interest is by making appeals to liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:44.139
    | text      = Minimum wage laws aren't about making sure that employees get a living wage, it's an
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:48.299
    | text      = attack on liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.500
    | text      = Employers can't pay less than a certain amount, which is actually an encroachment of the worker's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:55.139
    | text      = liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:56.259
    | text      = You can't take a job for less than minimum wage.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:59.340
    | text      = Shouldn't you be free to do that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:01.100
    | text      = Think about how the market would expand if you were just able to work for slave wages.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:05.820
    | text      = Makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.299
    | text      = Appeals to liberty are very often a mask to make it harder for people to realize that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:11.139
    | text      = certain right-wing positions directly harm them and common people at the expense of rich
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.440
    | text      = people and corporations.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.779
    | text      = This works because liberty rules and people want to be free.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:23.059
    | text      = Protecting liberty is important.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:24.940
    | text      = But if you pretend that it's the most important thing to you, it's very easy to make a lot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:29.419
    | text      = of really shitty political positions more palatable to a broader audience.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:34.720
    | text      = Because this is the case, and it's such an effective mask, it's important to be mindful
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:39.179
    | text      = about people whose identities are based around this concept of liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:43.940
    | text      = Right now, Alex Jones is supporting and running cover for a government that's detained a number
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:48.179
    | text      = of legal U.S. residents for things ranging from DWIs in the past to things that are definitely
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:54.580
    | text      = covered by free speech, like writing an op-ed in a college paper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:58.659
    | text      = In order to be the person that Alex pretends to be, he needs to be super against the violations
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:03.419
    | text      = of liberty that are being carried out by the U.S. government right now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:07.659
    | text      = The events that are happening require him to oppose Trump on principle and spend his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:11.779
    | text      = entire show highlighting these incidents and how they're a danger to you and your liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:17.500
    | text      = If the government can detain legal residents on student visas for their speech, Alex knows
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:22.220
    | text      = damn well that citizens aren't safe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:25.179
    | text      = Fundamentally, this is the issue that a bulk of his career is based on, for instance how
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:29.840
    | text      = the Patriot Act sought to make all crimes terrorism so the government could treat his
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:34.379
    | text      = dissenter friends as terrorists for just having different opinions.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:39.059
    | text      = Alex needs to have that position, because that's what his career would imply.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:45.340
    | text      = So I wanted to highlight how weird it is that Alex is still supporting Trump, and I thought
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:50.379
    | text      = that the best way to do that was to take you on a little journey through 2004, when
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:11:54.779
    | text      = Alex championed a very important case that was a real threat to American liberties.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.820
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:03.580
    | text      = How do you feel?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.580
    | text      = Uh, uh, uh, yeah!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.299
    | text      = Yeah!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:12.980
    | text      = So on February 16th, 2004, Alex did a little interview with Mel Gibson's dad about how
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.379
    | text      = he was totally not a Nazi.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:20.340
    | text      = Damn it!
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:21.340
    | text      = But that's not important.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:22.860
    | text      = That's not the most important thing that happened on that show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:25.820
    | text      = He also received a call from a guy named Kelly Rushing, who would go on to be very important
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.659
    | text      = in Alex's career.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:33.659
    | text      = Let's talk to Kelly in Kentucky.
}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:42.100
    | text      = I just put one to police officers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.740
    | text      = I made a mistake and put it in his mailbox, and now they're trying to prosecute me over
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.419
    | text      = it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:52.419
    | text      = Well, you know, we've had thousands of listeners make thousands of copies of the videos and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:57.179
    | text      = give them to police and deliver them to firefighters, and usually they get a positive response.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:02.059
    | text      = But you're telling me that you stuck it in the mailbox, and now they're trying to claim,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:06.019
    | text      = what, that it's a federal offense to stick something in a mailbox?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:09.419
    | text      = Well, no, they didn't even charge me with that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:13.059
    | text      = This first introduction between these two is important, because as Kelly begins to tell
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:17.700
    | text      = his story, he literally says that he made a mistake by putting one of Alex's tapes in
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.779
    | text      = a cop's mailbox.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:24.500
    | text      = Getting arrested for it is possibly an overreaction, but that was in response to him doing something
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:29.779
    | text      = that he says was a mistake.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:32.679
    | text      = On December 15, 2003, Kelly Rushing was arrested by Trooper Louie Dodd.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:37.700
    | text      = Dodd would go on to testify that in early November, he had found anti-government videos
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:41.899
    | text      = placed in his mailbox, which were left there by Rushing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.139
    | text      = Rushing admitted to all this from an article in the Herald-Ledger.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:48.299
    | text      = Quote, Dodd said that as a Kentucky State Police Trooper, he's part of the state government.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:54.139
    | text      = When I get a tape that's anti-government, I take offense to that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:57.700
    | text      = A month later, Dodd saw Rushing leaning out of the window of his car and putting something
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.059
    | text      = in his mailbox again.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:04.059
    | text      = Dodd got dressed and went out, eventually finding Rushing down the road on US 641, where
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.100
    | text      = he arrested him for menacing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.460
    | text      = It's unquestionably illegal to put things into other people's mailboxes or to tamper
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:15.940
    | text      = with mailboxes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:17.580
    | text      = You may disagree that this isn't how the law should be, but as things stood in 2003, Rushing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:23.700
    | text      = made a mistake, or at least two as it relates to Trooper Dodd.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:28.659
    | text      = There's a recording from Rushing's arrest where he says to Dodd, quote, your family
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:34.980
    | text      = is not safe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:37.019
    | text      = Dodd asked in response to that, quote, sounds like a threat to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:40.860
    | text      = Rushing replied, quote, it's not a threat.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:42.779
    | text      = I'm just trying to wake you up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:45.379
    | text      = From the standpoint of this officer, this shit was messed up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:49.299
    | text      = He had five kids at home, and someone he didn't know had now dropped off multiple anti-government
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:54.379
    | text      = tapes in his mailbox.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:56.019
    | text      = When he arrested him, the guy told him his family wasn't safe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:00.100
    | text      = Kelly made a mistake, and he didn't do himself any favors when the consequences of that mistake
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:04.700
    | text      = came around.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.139
    | text      = He was given a trial, and in April he was acquitted of all the charges, which is a pretty
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:09.899
    | text      = great deal for him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:11.620
    | text      = He ended up being accused of menacing and third-degree terrorist threatening, and it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:15.460
    | text      = probably fair to say that that is a bit of a stretch, but he definitely put unwanted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:21.419
    | text      = propaganda in a cop's mailbox, and he could have easily been charged and convicted with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:26.500
    | text      = that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:27.580
    | text      = As it stands on February 16th, when he's calling into Alex's show here, Rushing is between
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:32.779
    | text      = the arrest and the dropping of all charges on him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:35.879
    | text      = In effect, he is the human embodiment of that wet cement principle that I've talked about,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:41.679
    | text      = where Alex can make an impact in something, but only before the cement dries.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:46.679
    | text      = Once it dries, he can't do shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:48.559
    | text      = He's in that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:49.559
    | text      = He is that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:50.559
    | text      = Kelly exists as that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:52.840
    | text      = He's simultaneously being sent to prison for life and a free man, depending on how Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.240
    | text      = wants to tell this story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:00.159
    | text      = It's just fallen into his lap in an amazing way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:03.080
    | text      = Interesting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:04.080
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:05.679
    | text      = So this is a story of Alex's that lives on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:12.120
    | text      = It's one of the prime examples he has of his own oppression.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:15.919
    | text      = This guy got arrested for giving a cop one of my tapes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:19.559
    | text      = It's something that's repeated.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.120
    | text      = It's part of the mythology.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:24.360
    | text      = And because of that, I wanted to discuss how this mythology exists, how it built, and how
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:35.519
    | text      = Alex responded to this case of encroachment on liberty.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:39.759
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:40.759
    | text      = I mean, at the end of the day, I'm hearing there's a crybaby cop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:46.480
    | text      = That's all I'm hearing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:47.480
    | text      = Hey, I mean, look, that perspective is fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:53.720
    | text      = Let's take the fact that he's a cop out of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:56.000
    | text      = All you really remove is that the person wouldn't have been able to arrest him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:01.240
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:02.240
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:03.240
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:04.279
    | text      = They employed someone else to arrest Kelly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:07.400
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:08.400
    | text      = But they wouldn't have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:09.400
    | text      = They might have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:10.400
    | text      = In a small fucking town, they might have.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:11.839
    | text      = Doubtful.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:12.839
    | text      = That guy was abusing his bullshit powers 100%.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:16.119
    | text      = And we know that because he was acquitted.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:19.819
    | text      = So he's innocent of all charges.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:22.400
    | text      = That's how it works.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:24.400
    | text      = I think that as we go through this, you might come to understand or realize that the state
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:32.759
    | text      = really just wanted to give a slap on the wrist for this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:36.960
    | text      = Because this is bullshit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:38.960
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:39.960
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:40.960
    | text      = I don't understand what we're disagreeing on.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:44.039
    | text      = I'm just, I mean, I don't get what this whole...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:48.039
    | text      = Here's what I'm saying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:49.519
    | text      = I don't get the mythology of it beyond being like, this baby cop's crying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:17:56.680
    | text      = I guess I would say that if I project myself into the mind of a cop in a tiny town who
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:05.640
    | text      = has five kids, maybe...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:09.920
    | text      = I saw this person still on the force or was fairly recently.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:15.920
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:16.920
    | text      = So I'd have to assume that they're fairly young.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:18.799
    | text      = So maybe they don't have a ton of experience within law enforcement.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:22.559
    | text      = Maybe they're scared.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:24.359
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:25.599
    | text      = They're scared for their family's safety.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:28.240
    | text      = You can call that a baby, but I think that if I were just a civilian, just a normal person,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:35.720
    | text      = and I caught someone putting things that were somewhat inflammatory in my mailbox, and their
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:40.960
    | text      = response was, your family is not safe, I might react similarly to this guy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:46.559
    | text      = I might want...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:47.559
    | text      = I don't know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:48.559
    | text      = I don't think it's babyish.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:49.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:50.559
    | text      = I mean, I get that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:51.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:52.559
    | text      = But he was a fucking cop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:53.559
    | text      = So fuck him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:54.559
    | text      = What do you think he should do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:55.559
    | text      = He's a baby.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:56.559
    | text      = What do I think he should do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:57.559
    | text      = Get over himself.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:18:58.559
    | text      = Get over it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:00.440
    | text      = I would imagine...
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:01.440
    | text      = I mean, honestly, tell the guy not to do it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:04.440
    | text      = I would imagine that that was the point of stopping him in the first place, and then
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:08.880
    | text      = it escalated because he said, your family is not safe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:12.119
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:13.119
    | text      = It would never have escalated if he wasn't a cop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:16.039
    | text      = It's because he's a cop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:18.000
    | text      = It's because he's a cop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:19.240
    | text      = Well, it wouldn't have escalated because the person wouldn't have the authority to do a
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:24.160
    | text      = traffic stop.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:25.640
    | text      = Exactly.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:26.640
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:27.640
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:28.640
    | text      = That is the point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:30.880
    | text      = All right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:32.720
    | text      = I guess my point is that the decision is rational, and your point is that even if rational, it's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:39.160
    | text      = an abuse of power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:40.160
    | text      = Yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:41.160
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:42.160
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:43.160
    | text      = I will agree to disagree.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:44.160
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:45.160
    | text      = So Kelly describes his situation here, and this is the first that Alex is hearing of
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:49.559
    | text      = any of this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:50.559
    | text      = Okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:51.559
    | text      = Let me try to explain it to you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:52.960
    | text      = First, I had been going by this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:55.359
    | text      = He was a state trooper.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:19:57.039
    | text      = I went by his house for probably about a month before I did this, and on my way to work every
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:03.960
    | text      = morning I thought, well, it would be easy to try to inform him because I didn't think
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:07.599
    | text      = there was anything wrong with trying to inform people of authority in your area.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:12.559
    | text      = So I put the tape in his mailbox, the first one.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:16.200
    | text      = Well, evidently, he didn't know where it had come from or he didn't see me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:19.559
    | text      = Right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:20.559
    | text      = So I went ahead and went to work, and then about two weeks later I decided that I would
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:26.960
    | text      = put another one in his mailbox, another tape which confirmed your tape from other sources
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:34.200
    | text      = off of actually it came off the History Channel and C-SPAN and stuff like that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:38.559
    | text      = So you're a real radical.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:40.559
    | text      = Well, yeah, I guess.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:43.359
    | text      = But anyway, I put that one in his mailbox about two or three weeks later, and he saw
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:49.759
    | text      = me put it in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:20:51.759
    | text      = So he evidently waited on the highway where he knew I would probably come back down, and
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:01.440
    | text      = he waited for me that evening after work, and then when I came by, he pulled me over,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:06.680
    | text      = and basically he acted out just like the tape said he would.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:10.519
    | text      = I think it kind of hurt his pride or something.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:14.119
    | text      = But what did he do to you, this KGB officer that thinks that spreading information is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:19.240
    | text      = un-American so he needs to go ahead and arrest you?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:21.980
    | text      = What happened?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:22.980
    | text      = So Kelly's telling his story, and it's very clear that he's in the wrong.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:21:27.259
    | text      = He made a mistake by his own description, and he did it multiple times.

{{TranscriptBlock
